sdkFacades.source:
export { canonicalizeBase64 } from "packages/media-core/src/base64.ts";
export { rawDataToString } from "src/infra/ws.ts";

dataAudit.usage: complete parsed original JSON module default export

exports.isProviderAuthProfileConfigured: uninvoked profile-readiness binding; throws if called
exports.isProviderAuthProfileConfiguredAsync: uninvoked asynchronous profile-readiness binding; throws if called

exports.resolveApiKeyForProvider: uninvoked profile credential binding; explicit fixture secret short-circuits discovery

exports.normalizeResolvedSecretInputString: asserts explicit fixture value and path, then returns it; production secret resolution unexecuted

exports.OPENCLAW_VERSION: artifact-version fixture read from byte-verified pinned package.json; production build/filesystem/version discovery unexecuted

exports.WebSocket: uninvoked throwing constructor; no socket or streaming callback executes

exports.Buffer: host Node Buffer primitive only; complete original WebSocket data helper evaluated but uncalled

exports.resolveGeneratedMediaMaxBytes: asserts cfg={} and kind=audio, returns explicit 16 MiB fixture; production limit resolver unexecuted

exports.postJsonRequest: records supplied URL, Headers, body and timeout; synthetic POST JSON serialization plus successful Response and counted release; original HTTP implementation unexecuted and no fetch invoked
exports.assertOkOrThrowProviderError: asserts synthetic successful Response status and label; production error processing unexecuted
exports.readProviderBinaryResponse: records maxBytes and overflow callback presence, returns exact Response bytes; production bounded reader unexecuted
exports.readProviderJsonArrayFieldResponse: uninvoked voice-list reader; throws if called

exports.ssrfPolicyFromHttpBaseUrlAllowedOrigin: records normalized base URL, returns explicit synthetic policy token; original policy unexecuted
exports.fetchWithSsrFGuard: uninvoked voice-list HTTP binding; throws if called

hostAdaptation.config: Explicit atom snake API: voice_id/language/speed/response_format/base_url; raw reference voice/languageCode aliases stay oracle inputs only.
hostAdaptation.headers: Source native-origin OpenClaw User-Agent is captured; host retains its Req identity and makes no full-header parity claim.

limits: All 58,558 pinned tracked blobs verified before and after; 17 complete TypeScript modules and two original JSON inputs additionally checked against pinned Git blobs.
Whole-module execution means evaluation, not all exports; only buildXaiSpeechProvider, nested raw resolveConfig and ordinary successful synthesize/synthesizeTelephony callbacks execute.
Pure SDK facades contain export wiring only; original normalization, directive-parser construction, model manifest loading and xaiUserAgentHeaderFor execute. Directive parsing is unexecuted.
Fresh per-vector VM process.env={} and cfg={}; explicit fixture secret avoids environment/profile credential discovery; artifact version is a declared package.json fixture.

postJsonRequest records complete supplied request inputs. method=POST and bodyText are synthetic helper serialization, not executed production HTTP serialization or wire evidence; no real network or fetch call.
Successful synthetic HTTP returns eight opaque fixture bytes and counts one release; production bounded reader, policy, resource lifetime, MIME validation and audio decoding are unexecuted.
16 MiB maxBytes is a forwarded fixture, without boundary or overflow execution; 12345 ms is the forwarded request timeout and 2000 ms bounds VM/capture execution, not production timeout proof.
No streaming, listVoices, directives, Talk, auth, plugin registration, negative/error/failure/cancel/crash/race/threshold or real provider execution.
MP3/WAV/PCM/mulaw/alaw describe source file metadata only; native publication remains MP3/WAV in this batch. No codec conversion or new channel behavior.
Ordinary file/note results have voiceCompatible=false and no MIME/sample rate. Telephony forces pcm and returns sampleRate=24000 without fileExtension or voiceCompatible.
The native-origin source OpenClaw User-Agent is observable here; host Req identity differs and full header parity is excluded.
